scope: Conditional identification diagnostic. Each k interval is exactly the image of independently feasible fixed-autumn inner Fajr and Isha endpoint intervals; it is not a selected factor or evidence of a Diyanet rule.
selection: All 28 fixed city-years; no city-year removed. Trim 0/1/2 reported separately.
formula: A=R-Bf, D=Bi-S, q=D/N, k=A/D; R/S/N fixed at the existing autumn anchor. Require A>0 and 0<D<N (equivalently 0<q<1), with exact endpoint inclusion.
arithmetic: Fractions of stored binary floats and exact rational interval endpoints; endpoint inclusions propagated monotonically; no optimizer or epsilon.
